# Judith Chapter 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Judith 2 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/JDT_002_page_001.jpg

---

**2:1** And in-the eighteenth year, on-the twenty-second [day] of-the first month, there-was a word in-the house of Nebuchadnezzar king of-the Assyrians to-take-vengeance on all-the land, even-as he-had-spoken.

**2:2** And he-called together all-his servants and all-his great-ones and he-set-before them his secret counsel, and with-his own mouth he-detailed all-the evil against-the land;

**2:3** and they-decided to-destroy all who-had-not-obeyed the-word of-his mouth.

**2:4** And it-came-to-pass when he-had-finished his-counsel, Nebuchadnezzar king of-the Assyrians called Holofernes, the-chief commander of-his force, the-second [man] after him, and said to him:

**2:5** "Thus says the-great king, the-lord of all-the earth: Behold, you-will-go-out from before my face and you-will-take with-yourself men who-trust in their-own strength, [to] one-hundred-and-twenty thousand infantry and a body-of twelve-thousand cavalry;

**2:6** and you-will-go-out against all-the land of-the west, because they-disobeyed the-word of my mouth.

**2:7** And you-will-command to them that they-make-ready earth and water, because I-will-go-out in my wrath against them, and I-will-cover all-the face of-the earth with the-feet of my army, and I-will-give them as-plunder to them.

**2:8** And their slain-ones will-fill their ravines and every-[dry]-stream-bed and the-river will-be-filled with their dead, and every-overflow and valley of-the mountains will-be-filled with the-cast-out of-their flesh.

**2:9** And I-will-lead them captive to-the ends of all-the earth.

**2:10** But you, go and seize-in-advance for-me all their territory; and if they-give-themselves-over to-you, guard them for-me until the-day of-their reproof.

**2:11** But concerning those who-are-resistant, let-not your eye spare [them], but give [them] over to-slaughter and to-plunder in all-the land of-you.

**2:12** For by-my life and by-the power of my kingdom, I-have-spoken, and I-will-do this by my hand.

**2:13** And you, you-will-not-transgress anything from-the commands of-your lord, but you-will-carry-out [them] just-as I-have-commanded you, and you-will-not-delay to-do them."

**2:14** And Holofernes went-out from before the-face of-his lord and called all-the commanders and the-generals and the-officers of-the force of Assyria;

**2:15** and he-mustered chosen men for-the battle, as-his lord had-commanded him, to one-hundred-and-twenty thousand and twelve-thousand archers on-horseback,

**2:16** and he-arranged them as a great-multitude is-arranged for-war.

**2:17** And he-took camels and donkeys and mules for their-baggage, a very-great number; and sheep and oxen and goats for their-provisions without-number;

**2:18** and every-man [had] provision in-abundance and very-much gold and silver from-the house of-the king.

**2:19** And he-went-out, he and all-his force, for-the journey to-go-before the-face of King Nebuchadnezzar, and he-covered all-the face of-the western-region with their chariots and their cavalry and their chosen-infantry.

**2:20** And a mixed-multitude like locusts and like the-sand of-the earth went-along with them — there-was-no-counting of-the multitude.

**2:21** And they-went-out from Nineveh three days' journey toward-the plain of Bectileth, and they-encamped from Bectileth near the-mountain which is at-the left of Upper Cilicia.

**2:22** And he-took all-his army, his-infantry and cavalry and chariots, and he-went from there into the-hill-country.

**2:23** And he-devastated Phud and Lud and plundered all-the sons of Rasses and the-sons of Ishmael who were-facing the-desert to-the south of-the land of-the Chellaeans.

**2:24** And he-crossed over-the Euphrates and passed-through Mesopotamia and broke-down all-the high-walled cities that-were by-the brook Abron, until one-comes to-the sea.

**2:25** And he-seized the-territory of Cilicia and cut-down all-the ones-opposing him and came to-the borders of Japheth which were toward-the south facing Arabia.

**2:26** And he-encircled all-the sons of Midian and burned their tents and plundered their sheepfolds.

**2:27** And he-went-down into the-plain of Damascus in-the days of-the wheat-harvest and burned all their fields and destroyed their flocks and herds and plundered their cities and laid-waste their plains and struck all-their young-men with-the edge of-the sword.

**2:28** And the-fear of him and the-trembling of him fell upon-the ones inhabiting the-seacoast — those at Sidon and Tyre, and the-ones dwelling [in] Sur and Okina, and all-the ones dwelling in Jamnia — and those-inhabiting Azotus and Ascalon feared him exceedingly.
